scope: Full 64-layer model plus split device sampler, real weights and synthetic populated caches; three restored-state trace replays, not natural-prompt accuracy or unprofiled serving throughput
accounting: Each rank's firmware intervals form a disjoint timeline with explicit overlap and gaps. Firmware includes waits; this is not compute-active time. Longest rank span is compared to the same fenced two-trace host step. No cross-chip clock alignment or summed rank duration is used.
